ideas.title: Fly Dragons for Gold
ideas.hook: Your dragon is a flying taxi. Pick up knights, merchants and wizards across a floating kingdom and race the clock to drop them off for gold.
core_loop: Take a fare from the dragon stable board
Fly the route through rings, storms and castle gates
Get paid by time, tips and a smooth landing
Hatch dragon eggs for faster, tougher mounts
ideas.twist: Every passenger changes how the dragon flies: a heavy knight drags you low, a wizard lets you blink through one wall, a thief might jump off with your tip.
monetization: VIP stable with a rare egg each week
retention: Dragon egg index with shiny variants
Limited event routes (storm night, festival week)
ideas.why_now: Vehicle Sim jumped from 0.83 to 1.72 momentum this week (+0.89), led by [🎃] Bike Universe (55.4K CCU) and Kukirin Life (45.5K). Job / shift is up 0.41 to 1.24 (Save the Krusty Krab 20.4K, Firefighting Sim 15.0K) and Fantasy rose 0.55 to 1.41.
ideas.differentiator: Open-world ride games are about free roaming; this gives every flight a job, a timer and a passenger with a quirk, inside a fantasy world instead of a city.

ideas.title: Spot Supercars for Cash
ideas.hook: Ride around a city with a camera. Snap the rare cars driving past, fill your spotter book and sell the best shots to car magazines.
core_loop: Scoot or bike through the city looking for cars
Chase and photograph a car before it leaves
Sell photos at the magazine stand by rarity and quality
Upgrade your ride and camera lens to catch faster cars
ideas.twist: Hypercars only appear for a few minutes at random spots, and the whole server sees a flare when one spawns, so everyone races to the same corner.
retention: Spotter book with every car and colour
Daily featured car with bonus pay
ideas.why_now: The Vehicles theme climbed 0.67 this week to 1.65, with [🎃] Bike Universe (55.4K), [🎃] Bike For Egg! (44.3K) and Firefighting Sim (15.0K). Vehicle Sim is at 1.72 (+0.89) and open-world maps sit at 1.32 across 25 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Car games let you drive or steal cars; here the cars are wildlife and the camera is the tool, so a slow scooter player can still own the rarest card.

ideas.title: Toss Astronauts for Stars
ideas.hook: Grab a floppy astronaut and hurl them out of the airlock. They tumble through zero gravity, bounce off asteroids and earn stars for every metre.
core_loop: Wind up and throw an astronaut out of the station
Watch them ragdoll and bounce off asteroids
Each throw gives +1 arm power
Hatch new astronauts with better suits and bounce
ideas.twist: Asteroids are bumpers: a lucky chain of bounces can carry a weak throw past the moon into a new zone.
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim rose 0.87 this week to 2.22, led by Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (47.3K) and Crazy Diver (14.3K). Hit / swing / launch is at 2.18 (+0.36) and the Space theme is up 0.46 to 1.39 ([W2] +1 Slinky Escape 7.0K).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are about hurting a body on the ground; zero gravity turns the ragdoll into a pinball, so the fun is in the bounces.

ideas.title: +1 Oxygen Tank
ideas.hook: Every step on the alien planet gives +1 oxygen. Walk further from the base each run before your air runs out, and hatch the alien eggs you find out there.
core_loop: Walk out from the base for +1 oxygen per step
Grab alien eggs in deeper craters
Sprint back before your tank empties
Hatch eggs for pets that boost oxygen gain
ideas.twist: Dust storms sweep the map and drain air faster, so you have to pick between pushing deeper or hiding in a crashed rover until it passes.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula jumped 0.72 this week to 2.30 and +1 stat per action is at 2.12 (+0.66), with [🌍WORLD 2] +1 Venom Evolution (21.1K) and [🎃]+1 Assassin Leveling (15.1K). Space rose 0.46 to 1.39.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games just count up; here the stat is also your timer, so every run is a small survival trip with a real risk of losing the eggs you carry.

ideas.title: Spin Records for Cash
ideas.hook: Run a tiny record shop. Customers walk in humming a vibe, you pick a record, spin it on the deck and they buy it if they start dancing.
core_loop: Read what the customer wants from their mood bubble
Pick a record and play a short timing beat on the deck
Sell it and earn tips for perfect spins
Dig through crates for rare records to fill your collection
ideas.twist: Some customers bring their own weird requests (a song for a cat, a song for a breakup), and nailing them unlocks rare records you can't buy.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 0.37 this week to 2.04, led by 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (82.2K) and Fix My Phone! (10.1K). Job / shift rose 0.41 to 1.24 and interior maps sit at 1.82 across 24 new games. Music holds steady at 1.35 (+1 Dance Battle Evolution 13.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell food or junk by clicking; here every sale is a tiny rhythm moment, and the product is music the whole server can hear.

ideas.title: Snowman Defense ⛄
ideas.hook: Lava monsters crawl down the mountain toward your igloo village. Roll snowballs, stack them into snowman towers and freeze the wave before it melts your home.
core_loop: Shovel snow between waves
Roll and stack snowmen on the path
Each snowman type throws ice, slush or blizzards
Upgrade the village to unlock bigger towers
ideas.twist: Snowmen slowly melt near the lava path, so you trade off between strong towers close to the lane and safer ones further back.
monetization: Luck pass for rare snowman hats
ideas.why_now: Tower defense is up 0.22 this week to 1.65, led by [💰X2] Cameraman Tower Defense (37.4K) and [🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense (8.3K). Voxel / blocky art is at 2.07 across 7 new games, and Ice / fire holds at 1.30 ([UPD] Firefighting Sim 15.0K).
ideas.differentiator: Tower defense units are usually bought; here you physically roll and stack them, and the melting gives every tower a lifespan you manage.

ideas.title: +1 Fire Breath
ideas.hook: Every breath gives +1 flame size. Melt the frozen walls in the glacier and crack open the treasure chests trapped inside.
core_loop: Breathe fire for +1 flame size
Melt ice walls to reach deeper caves
Thaw frozen chests and pets
Hatch fire pets that boost flame gain
ideas.twist: Other players can blow frost to refreeze your wall, so teaming up melts walls far faster than going alone.
retention: Rebirth into a hotter flame colour
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula rose 0.72 to 2.30 and +1 stat per action is at 2.12 (+0.66), with [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping (24.3K) and [🎃] +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs (18.2K). Ice / fire is steady at 1.30 with [🎃]Melt All The Ice!🧊 among its new games.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games rarely let players help or block each other; shared walls and frost blowing make each server a small team game.

ideas.title: Bank Teller [Anomaly] 💵
ideas.hook: Work the night window at a strange bank. Count the cash, stamp the slips and spot the bills, customers and vault doors that are not quite right.
core_loop: Serve a customer: count, stamp, hand over
Check bills and faces for anomalies
Report anomalies before closing time
Spend wages to upgrade your counter and vault
ideas.twist: The anomalies are in the money itself: a portrait that blinks, a serial number that changes, a stack that grows when you look away.
ideas.why_now: Job / shift rose 0.41 this week to 1.24 (Aisles Of The Locust 15.9K, Save the Krusty Krab 20.4K), Story is up 0.59 to 1.30 and Money / rich climbed 0.58 to 2.16. Interior maps sit at 1.82 with 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 at 82.2K.
ideas.differentiator: Anomaly games usually hide oddities in a room; here they hide in the thing you handle all shift, so every bill is a small puzzle.

ideas.title: Paint the Portraits 🖼️
ideas.hook: You are the painter at an old manor. Guests sit for portraits each night, but the paintings keep changing when you turn around, and some guests never leave.
core_loop: Paint the guest sitting in the chair
Hang the portrait in the long hallway
Walk the hall and spot portraits that changed
Fix or burn the wrong ones before morning
ideas.twist: What you paint matters: a sloppy portrait gives the ghost an easier way out, so careful art is your defence.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is the fastest mechanic at 2.51 (+0.60 this week), led by Kukirin Life (45.5K) and Backseat Rally (41.4K). Story is up 0.59 to 1.30 ([UPD] Something is Wrong With My Dog... 12.8K) and interior maps sit at 1.82.
inspired_by: [UPD] Something is Wrong With My Dog...
ideas.differentiator: Paint games are cheerful money makers; this puts the brush inside a horror loop, where your own drawings are the clues and the threat.

ideas.title: Draw Maps for Adventurers
ideas.hook: Explore a wild fantasy land, then draw the map yourself. Adventurers buy your maps, and if your paths are right they come back rich and tip you.
core_loop: Explore and climb to scout new areas
Draw paths, caves and danger marks on parchment
Sell maps at your shop in town
Upgrade inks, compass and shop to sell bigger maps
ideas.twist: Adventurers actually follow your drawing: a wrong turn walks them off a cliff and they come back angry for a refund.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create leads all mechanics at 2.51 (+0.60), with [✍️]DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA (5.4K) bringing drawing to fantasy. Fantasy rose 0.55 to 1.41, Sell / run a shop is at 2.04 (+0.37) and low poly art is at 1.81.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games are judged by looks; here the drawing is functional, so being accurate earns more than being pretty.
